string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: New Network section in Tools: Speed test, Hotspot, Private DNS (now its own tool) and Downdetector.
Speed test: ping, jitter, download and upload with a live gauge and local history.
Downdetector: opens the outage page of a service for your country, with favourites.
Drinking fountains: a map of public drinking-water points from OpenStreetMap, the last tool in Measure & location.
Apps → Background: Restricted / Optimized / Unrestricted, block background mobile data, soft stop and reviewed apps with restore, like NoMoreBackground.
Home double tap is less sensitive: taps on icons and page swipes no longer count.
